route_note: Take the JR Yokosuka Line from Tokyo Station directly to Kamakura (about an hour), then walk or use the Enoden tram for the Great Buddha and Hase area.
Take the Tobu Nikko Line limited express from Asakusa or the JR Tohoku Shinkansen to Utsunomiya then the JR Nikko Line; from Nikko Station a bus reaches the shrine area.
Take the Odakyu Romancecar from Shinjuku to Hakone-Yumoto, then use the Hakone Tozan railway, cable car, and ropeway to loop around the sights.
see: Lake Ashi and pirate ship cruise

route_note: Take the Fuji Excursion limited express from Shinjuku direct to Kawaguchiko, or a highway bus from Shinjuku; local buses connect the lake viewpoints.
see: Lake Kawaguchi north shore views of Mt Fuji
tour_query: Mt Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi day trip from Tokyo

route_note: Take the JR Tokaido or Yokosuka Line from Tokyo Station or the Tokyu Toyoko Line from Shibuya directly to Yokohama, about 30 minutes.
